issue.title: helm template --output-dir issue with nested template directory
issue.body:
<!-- If you need help or think you have found a bug, please help us with your issue by entering the following information (otherwise you can delete this text): -->

Output of `helm version`: version.BuildInfo{Version:"v3.1.0", GitCommit:"b29d20baf09943e134c2fa5e1e1cab3bf93315fa", GitTreeState:"clean", GoVersion:"go1.13.7"}

Output of `kubectl version`: Client Version: version.Info{Major:"1", Minor:"17", GitVersion:"v1.17.0", GitCommit:"70132b0f130acc0bed193d9ba59dd186f0e634cf", GitTreeState:"clean", BuildDate:"2019-12-07T21:20:10Z", GoVersion:"go1.13.4", Compiler:"gc", Platform:"linux/amd64"}
Server Version: version.Info{Major:"1", Minor:"15", GitVersion:"v1.15.10", GitCommit:"1bea6c00a7055edef03f1d4bb58b773fa8917f11", GitTreeState:"clean", BuildDate:"2020-02-11T20:05:26Z", GoVersion:"go1.12.12", Compiler:"gc", Platform:"linux/amd64"}


Cloud Provider/Platform (AKS, GKE, Minikube etc.): Self-hosted cluster on AWS using KOPS

There seems to be an issue with `helm template` while saving charts with nested templates like [ingress-nginx](https://github.com/kubernetes/ingress-nginx/tree/master/charts/ingress-nginx). The templates for this chart are placed in multiple nested directories, namely, `templates`, `templates/admission-webhooks` and `templates/admission-webhooks/job-patch`. The templates are rendered properly, however only the templates within `templates` and `templates/admission-webhooks` are saved when using the option `--output-dir`. The templates within `templates/admission-webhooks/job-patch` are not saved but rendered to the `stdout`. This causes issues as we are rendering the template through helm and performing a `kubectl apply` and since the templates within `templates/admission-webhooks/job-patch` are not saved, they don't get applied.

When I do a helm upgrade directly(had to upgrade another company chart with ingress-nginx where we use helm install/upgrade directly, unlike above), all the templates are installed/upgraded properly. There seems to a problem only while saving the nested templates to the output directory.

`helm template --output-dir` is already supporting 1 level of nested directory. Can we extend it further? Can we also document it somewhere and showcase it in `lint` commands that the maximum allowed nested directories within `templates` is `x`.
